note: MOD-0048-FU01 §21 (TRM-17): Treasury (FinanceTreasury) consumable sets; module stays BusinessReferenceData because the production loader accepts no other module (invalid_catalog_module). payment-method carries codes only; display_name = English, UI labels come from the consumer's PaymentMethod.{CODE} resx keys (7 tenant languages), not from this set. currency-minor-units (ISO 4217 minor units, attributes.minorUnits) is added once the ISO 4217 list is supplied; catalog_version then names the ISO edition.

sets.description: Governed list of payment methods (MOD-0126 PaymentMethod, D28 / O-13). Platform wide; a published and active code is valid, any other code is refused by the Treasury consumer.

values.description: Transfer within the domestic clearing system.
